# PWDnow

> Zero-knowledge, local-first password manager. All credential encryption and
> decryption happens client-side or in a local vault daemon — the server never
> sees plaintext vault data.

PWDnow stores credentials, secure notes, and asset-holder records in an
encrypted vault. Most application routes require authentication and are not
useful to crawlers; the links below are the public entry points.

## Pages

- [Login](/login): Sign in to an existing vault.
- [Register](/register): Create a new account.
- [Forgot password](/forgot-password): Account recovery flow.
